REST API for the OpenStatus open-source synthetic monitoring and status-page platform. Manage HTTP, TCP, and DNS uptime monitors across 28 global regions, publish status pages, file status reports, work incidents, and run on-demand checks. Authenticate with an API key in the x-openstatus-key header.
